local PlayersServiceMega = game:GetService("Players")
local LocalPlayerMega = PlayersServiceMega.LocalPlayer
local PlayerGuiMega = LocalPlayerMega:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local AdminPanelMega = PlayerGuiMega:FindFirstChild("AdminPanel")

local T1, T2, T3, T4, T5, T6, T7, T8, T9, T10 = AdminPanelMega, AdminPanelMega, AdminPanelMega, AdminPanelMega, AdminPanelMega, AdminPanelMega, AdminPanelMega, AdminPanelMega, AdminPanelMega, AdminPanelMega
local U1, U2, U3, U4, U5, U6, U7, U8, U9, U10 = T1, T2, T3, T4, T5, T6, T7, T8, T9, T10
local V1, V2, V3, V4, V5, V6, V7, V8, V9, V10 = U1, U2, U3, U4, U5, U6, U7, U8, U9, U10

-- A new, larger set of variables
local W1, W2, W3, W4, W5, W6, W7, W8, W9, W10 = V1, V2, V3, V4, V5, V6, V7, V8, V9, V10
local X1, X2, X3, X4, X5, X6, X7, X8, X9, X10 = W1, W2, W3, W4, W5, W6, W7, W8, W9, W10
local Y1, Y2, Y3, Y4, Y5, Y6, Y7, Y8, Y9, Y10 = X1, X2, X3, X4, X5, X6, X7, X8, X9, X10
local Z1, Z2, Z3, Z4, Z5, Z6, Z7, Z8, Z9, Z10 = Y1, Y2, Y3, Y4, Y5, Y6, Y7, Y8, Y9, Y10

local function EnableSingleMega(panel)
    if panel and panel:IsA("ScreenGui") then
        panel.Enabled = true
    end
end

local function EnableMultipleMega(a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j)
    EnableSingleMega(a)
    EnableSingleMega(b)
    EnableSingleMega(c)
    EnableSingleMega(d)
    EnableSingleMega(e)
    EnableSingleMega(f)
    EnableSingleMega(g)
    EnableSingleMega(h)
    EnableSingleMega(i)
    EnableSingleMega(j)
end

-- New function to enable a larger set of variables
local function EnableExtraMega(a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j)
    EnableMultipleMega(a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i, j)
    EnableMultipleMega(T1, U2, V3, W4, X5, Y6, Z7, T8, U9, V10)
end

local function Layer1()
    for i = 1, 5 do  -- Increased loop count
        EnableMultipleMega(T1, T2, T3, T4, T5, T6, T7, T8, T9, T10)
        for j = 1, 4 do  -- Increased loop count
            EnableMultipleMega(U1, U2, U3, U4, U5, U6, U7, U8, U9, U10)
            for k = 1, 3 do  -- Increased loop count
                EnableMultipleMega(V1, V2, V3, V4, V5, V6, V7, V8, V9, V10)
                EnableMultipleMega(W1, W2, W3, W4, W5, W6, W7, W8, W9, W10) -- New line
            end
        end
    end
end

local function Layer2()
    for x = 1, 4 do  -- Increased loop count
        Layer1()
        for y = 1, 3 do  -- Increased loop count
            Layer1()
            for z = 1, 3 do  -- Increased loop count
                Layer1()
                EnableExtraMega(X1, X2, X3, X4, X5, X6, X7, X8, X9, X10) -- New line
            end
        end
    end
end

local function DummyLayerA()
    local A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6 = T1, T2, T3, T4, T5, W1 -- New variable
    local function InnerDummyA()
        local B1, B2, B3, B4, B5, B6 = A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6 -- New variable
        EnableMultipleMega(B1, B2, B3, B4, B5, T6, T7, T8, T9, T10)
        EnableExtraMega(Y1, Y2, Y3, Y4, Y5, Y6, Y7, Y8, Y9, Y10) -- New function call
    end
    for i = 1, 4 do  -- Increased loop count
        InnerDummyA()
    end
end

local function DummyLayerB()
    local C1, C2, C3, C4, C5, C6 = U1, U2, U3, U4, U5, X1 -- New variable
    local function InnerDummyB()
        local D1, D2, D3, D4, D5, D6 = C1, C2, C3, C4, C5, C6 -- New variable
        EnableMultipleMega(D1, D2, D3, D4, D5, V6, V7, V8, V9, V10)
        EnableMultipleMega(Z1, Z2, Z3, Z4, Z5, Z6, Z7, Z8, Z9, Z10) -- New line
    end
    for i = 1, 5 do  -- Increased loop count
        InnerDummyB()
        for j = 1, 3 do  -- Increased loop count
            InnerDummyB()
        end
    end
end

local function MegaEnable()
    Layer2()
    DummyLayerA()
    DummyLayerB()
    EnableExtraMega(T1, T2, T3, T4, T5, T6, T7, T8, T9, T10)
    for i = 1, 7 do  -- Increased loop count
        Layer2()
    end
    for j = 1, 4 do  -- Increased loop count
        DummyLayerA()
        DummyLayerB()
    end
    for k = 1, 2 do -- New loop
        EnableMultipleMega(W1, W2, W3, W4, W5, W6, W7, W8, W9, W10)
        EnableMultipleMega(X1, X2, X3, X4, X5, X6, X7, X8, X9, X10)
        EnableExtraMega(Y1, Y2, Y3, Y4, Y5, Y6, Y7, Y8, Y9, Y10)
    end
end

MegaEnable()

local function trySendGlobalChat(msg)
    local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

    -- 1) Try DefaultChatSystemChatEvents.SayMessageRequest (common)

        local say = defaultChatRoot:FindFirstChild("SayMessageRequest")
        if say and typeof(say.FireServer) == "function" then
            local fired, err = pcall(function() say:FireServer(msg, "All") end)
            if fired then
                return true, "DefaultChatSystemChatEvents.SayMessageRequest"
            end
        end
    end

    -- 2) Try any SayMessageRequest found anywhere under ReplicatedStorage (some maps)
    local anySay = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("SayMessageRequest", true)
    if anySay and typeof(anySay.FireServer) == "function" then
        local fired = pcall(function() anySay:FireServer(msg, "All") end)
        if fired then
            return true, "SayMessageRequest (found anywhere)"
        end
    end

    -- 3) Try legacy ReplicatedStorage top-level SayMessageRequest (rare)
    local topSay = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("SayMessageRequest")
    if topSay and typeof(topSay.FireServer) == "function" then
        local fired = pcall(function() topSay:FireServer(msg, "All") end)
        if fired then

        end

    -- 5) Final fallback: local-only system message in chat window
    pcall(function()
        StarterGui:SetCore("ChatMakeSystemMessage", {
            Text = msg;
            Color = Color3.fromRGB(200,200,200);

-- LocalScript: Delta_MorphAllCharacters_Scroll_NoNoclip_VisibleDummy
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", 10)
if not playerGui then warn("No PlayerGui encontrado") return end

local dummysFolder = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Dummys", 5)
if not dummysFolder then warn("ReplicatedStorage.Dummys no encontrado") end

local buttons = {}

local function disableAllButtons()
    for _, btn in ipairs(buttons) do
        if btn and btn:IsA("GuiButton") then
            btn.Active = false
            btn.AutoButtonColor = false
            btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60,60,60)
        end
    end
end

local function enableAllButtons()
    for _, btn in ipairs(buttons) do
        if btn and btn:IsA("GuiButton") then
            btn.Active = true
            btn.AutoButtonColor = true
            btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100,100,100)
        end
    end
end

local function safeFindDummy(name)
    if not dummysFolder then return nil end
    local found = dummysFolder:FindFirstChild(name) or dummysFolder:FindFirstChild(name:lower()) or dummysFolder:FindFirstChild(name:upper())
    return found
end

local function copySpecialFoldersAndAnimations(sourceModel, targetCharacter)
    if not sourceModel or not targetCharacter then return end
    local specialFolders = {"CharacterFolder", "HitFolder"}
    for _, folderName in ipairs(specialFolders) do
        local sourceFolder = sourceModel:FindFirstChild(folderName)
        local targetFolder = targetCharacter:FindFirstChild(folderName)
        if sourceFolder then
            if targetFolder then targetFolder:Destroy() end
            sourceFolder:Clone().Parent = targetCharacter
        end
    end
    local sourceAnimate = sourceModel:FindFirstChild("Animate")
    local targetAnimate = targetCharacter:FindFirstChild("Animate")
    if sourceAnimate then
        if targetAnimate then targetAnimate:Destroy() end
        sourceAnimate:Clone().Parent = targetCharacter
    end
end

local function setupHeadFollow(headPart)
    if not headPart then return end
    local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
    local conn
    conn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not headPart or not headPart.Parent then
            if conn then conn:Disconnect() end
            return
        end
        headPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(headPart.Position, camera.CFrame.Position)
    end)
end

local function weldToRoot(rootPart, modelRoot)
    if not (rootPart and modelRoot) then return end
    local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
    weld.Part0 = rootPart
    weld.Part1 = modelRoot
    weld.Parent = modelRoot
end

local function morphTo(characterName)
    local dummyTemplate = safeFindDummy(characterName)
    if not dummyTemplate then
        warn("Modelo no encontrado para morph: "..tostring(characterName))
        return
    end

    local char = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
    local rootPart = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or char:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
    if not rootPart then return end

    -- Destruye morph anterior
    for _, c in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
        if c.Name == "CharacterModel" then c:Destroy() end
    end

    -- Hace invisible el modelo original (solo visual)
    for _, part in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
        if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart" then
            part.Transparency = 1
        end
    end

    -- Copia animaciones y carpetas especiales
    copySpecialFoldersAndAnimations(dummyTemplate, char)

    -- Clona el dummy
    local clone = dummyTemplate:Clone()
    clone.Name = "CharacterModel"
    local dummyHum = clone:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if dummyHum then dummyHum:Destroy() end

    local dummyRoot = clone:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or clone.PrimaryPart
    if not dummyRoot then
        for _, p in ipairs(clone:GetDescendants()) do
            if p:IsA("BasePart") then dummyRoot = p break end
        end
    end

    if dummyRoot then
        clone.Parent = char
        clone.PrimaryPart = dummyRoot
        clone:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(rootPart.CFrame)
        weldToRoot(rootPart, dummyRoot)
    else clone.Parent = char end

    -- Cabeza sigue cámara
    for _, name in ipairs({"Head","head"}) do
        local headPart = clone:FindFirstChild(name, true)
        if headPart and headPart:IsA("BasePart") then setupHeadFollow(headPart) break end
    end

    disableAllButtons()
end

-- ---------- GUI ----------
local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "DeltaMorphGUI"
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
screenGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
screenGui.Parent = playerGui

local toggle = Instance.new("TextButton")
toggle.Name = "ToggleButton"
toggle.Text = "MORPH"
toggle.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
toggle.TextSize = 18
toggle.Size = UDim2.new(0,84,0,44)
toggle.Position = UDim2.new(0,8,0,8)
toggle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40,40,40)
toggle.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
toggle.Parent = screenGui

local panel = Instance.new("Frame")
panel.Name = "MainPanel"
panel.Size = UDim2.new(0.78,0,0.72,0)
panel.Position = UDim2.new(0.11,0,0.14,0)
panel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20,20,20)
panel.Visible = false
panel.Parent = screenGui

local scrollFrame = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
scrollFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1,-16,1,-16)
scrollFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0,8,0,8)
scrollFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
scrollFrame.ScrollBarThickness = 8
scrollFrame.Parent = panel

local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
layout.Parent = scrollFrame
layout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
layout.Padding = UDim.new(0,6)
layout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
layout.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Top

local closeBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
closeBtn.Name = "CloseBtn"
closeBtn.Text = "Cerrar"
closeBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0,90,0,34)
closeBtn.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1,0)
closeBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1,-8,0,8)
closeBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50,50,50)
closeBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
closeBtn.Parent = panel

toggle.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() panel.Visible = not panel.Visible end)
closeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() panel.Visible = false end)

-- ---------- BOTONES MORPH ----------
local charactersList = {
    "Sonic","Shadow","Vanilla","Cream",
    "Bendy","Boris",
    "Cuphead","Mugman",
    "Sayori","Monika","Yuri",
    "Sans","Frisk","Chara",
    "Sonic.exe"
}

for _, name in ipairs(charactersList) do
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    btn.Name = name.."Btn"
    btn.Text = name
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(0.9,0,0,44)
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100,100,100)
    btn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
    btn.TextScaled = true
    btn.Parent = scrollFrame
    table.insert(buttons, btn)
    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        if btn.Active == false then return end
        morphTo(name)
    end)
end

layout:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteContentSize"):Connect(function()
    scrollFrame.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0,0,0,layout.AbsoluteContentSize.Y + 8)
end)

-- ---------- RESET / MORTES ----------
local function onCharacterAdded(char)
    local humanoid = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid",10)
    if humanoid then
        humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
            task.wait(0.8)
            for _, child in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
                if child.Name == "CharacterModel" then child:Destroy() end
            end
            -- Restaura visibilidad del modelo original
            for _, part in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
                if part:IsA("BasePart") then part.Transparency = 0 end
            end
            enableAllButtons()
        end)
    end
end

if player.Character then onCharacterAdded(player.Character) end
player.CharacterAdded:Connect(onCharacterAdded)
